text: Code reviews are an essential part of modern software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, when problems are still cheap and easy to fix. This saves the team time and prevents small mistakes from becoming serious issues later. Code reviews also encourage knowledge sharing, because reviewers learn how their colleagues solve problems and become familiar with different parts of the codebase. Finally, regular reviews improve team quality, as shared standards and honest feedback help everyone write cleaner, safer code.
